name: trainconnect-mobile
description: TrainConnect Europe – Mobile App (iOS & Android) via Capacitor

scripts.build:android: cross-env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://10.0.2.2:5000 npm run build --prefix ../../frontend && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:ios: cross-env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:5000 npm run build --prefix ../../frontend && npx cap sync ios
scripts.build:device: cross-env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://YOUR_PC_IP:5000 npm run build --prefix ../../frontend && npx cap sync
